usage.search: search "<JQL>" [--limit N] [--json]       find issues by JQL
usage.transitions: transitions <KEY> [--json]                 list the statuses the issue can move to
usage.transition: transition <KEY> <status name>             move the issue to a named status
usage.conventions: conventions [--json]                       list the templates, skills and saved templates this project already has for tickets
usage.template: template save ticket --file <path> [--force] | show ticket   keep or print the project's ticket template

args.bodyRequired: Give the text with exactly one of --body <text> or --body-file <path>.
args.badLimit: --limit must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.

credentials.missing: Missing {names}. Add the Jira account, with its site URL, in Lantern (command palette, Integrations); runs started from Lantern then get it for the project. Nothing else needs to be set up.

reason.noAccount: Lantern has no Jira account yet: add one in Lantern (command palette, Integrations), then choose an account for this project in Integrations.
reason.chooseAccount: No Jira account is chosen for this project: choose an account for this project in Integrations (command palette, Integrations).
reason.storeUnavailable: Lantern could not read the stored account (its secret store is locked or unavailable); unlock it and try again.
reason.unknownProject: This folder is not a project opened in Lantern; open it there.
reason.notRunning: Lantern is not running or does not answer; start it.

credentials.badSite: {name} must be the https URL of the Jira site, for example https://example.atlassian.net.

hint.401: The account was not accepted; check it in Lantern (command palette, Integrations).
hint.403: The account may lack permission for this.
hint.404: Not found, or the account cannot see it.

jira.badKey: "{key}" is not an issue key such as PROJ-123.
jira.noTransitions: No transitions are available from the current status.
jira.noSuchTransition: {key} cannot move to "{status}". It can move to: {available}.

conventions.none: Nothing found: no ticket template in the repository, no skill about it and no saved template.
conventions.savedLine: ticket template saved for this project ({kind})

template.badAction: The first argument must be one of: {actions}.
template.badKind: The kind "{kind}" is not one for Jira; use one of: {kinds}.
template.exists: A template is already saved at {path}; pass --force to replace it.
template.absent: No {kind} template is saved for this project.
